last_funding.notes: The company's funding announcement identifies the $50 million Series C as its latest publicly announced round.

launched_6mo.notes: The newsroom is readable and its latest dated launch-type product item found was the 2023 data-intelligence feature; 2026 newsroom items are awards, not product launches. The newly labeled No-Code Design Suite has no public launch date.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists tiered plans and prices.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile identifies company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current openings include Enterprise Account Executive.

model_provider.notes: No public product statement specifying an AI model or model provider was found in the product documentation, company blog, or security material reviewed.

named_customers.notes: Oscar appears in a customer case study; Covertree appears in a case study listing. Oscar is the name used on Lob's cited case study.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page surfaced an Enterprise Account Executive and other roles in search results, but accessible current openings did not provide a complete role list to establish whether an AI/ML role is open.

compliance_certs.notes: Lob says it completes annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits. HIPAA and GDPR are discussed as compliance frameworks or support, not as certifications named as such.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public docs were available, but the materials reviewed did not identify an internal CRM or sales/marketing system used by Lob; no job posting or integration page naming one was found.

product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes automating and personalizing direct mail at scale through its nationwide print network.
product_one_liner.value: Lob provides a direct-mail automation platform and API that helps businesses create, personalize, print, route, and track mail at scale.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On November 12, 2025 Lob announced appointments of a CFO, CPO, and CRO, within the 12-month window.
